title: Signature Manual of the Twin Tides
summary: The school manual of the two tides that rise and fall together and teaches the student to strike on the flood and guard on the ebb.

title: The Basin Dewfall Signature Course
summary: The school course of the settling dew that heals the wounded and cleanses the poisoned and builds toward a rite of renewal.

title: Dual-Track Crest Signature Manual
summary: The school manual of the cresting wave run down two tracks at once that carries strike and counter in one curve of qi.

title: The Hawk and Azure Plunge Signature
summary: The school manual of the deep plunge in which the hawk's stoop is carried down into water and the diver returns with the strike.

title: Twin-Court Tidal Signature
summary: The school manual of the tide drawn through a formed core and held in two courts of qi that rise together to crown the student.

title: The Wind-Sworn Freshet Signature
summary: The school manual of the sudden freshet that a wind-sworn student swears to the open ground and sends along the bearing.

title: Oath of the Brimful Water
summary: The school oath of the brimful vessel that shares its overflow with allies and returns the fallen to their feet.

title: The Plateau Runoff Signature
summary: The school manual of the runoff that gathers across the open plateau into one great drawing flow held on a bearing.

title: The Unwalled Whirlpool Signature
summary: The school manual of the open whirlpool with no wall around it that draws in the foe and the loose qi alike.

title: The Sworn Wellspring Signature
summary: The school manual of the wellspring sworn to the formed core that feeds allies without end and returns the fallen.
